conditions.profile: Non-hosted profiles with arena_strategy none and native revival do not own exclusive arenas

change.summary: Separate per-entity World Tier enrollment from exclusive arena identity and archive inappropriate legacy ownership without deleting mobs or progression

modifiers.before: Every verified arena-bound progression entity competed for one saved living UUID
modifiers.after: Exclusive identity applies only to a hosted, explicitly arena-owned or JEM-scheduled profile. Other enrolled mobs retain independent encounter snapshots and progression without an arena claim

modifiers.before: Legacy ordinary-mob claims and conflicts persist and can suppress direct death progression
modifiers.after: After profile load or reload, archive nonexclusive active claims, conflicts, retirement and creation intent in existing SchemaVersion 2 WorldTierData. Preserve historical arena geometry, defeats, thresholds, entities and Paladin support ownership. Loaded ordinary entities detach only the inappropriate arena binding

rationale.purpose: Allow legitimate multi-mob populations while preserving World Tier progression and the Paladin's canonical support group
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly requested fixing ownership and migrating existing conflicting records before the quest redesign, with development-profile delivery only
rationale.implementation_choice: One profile-owned predicate, deferred save-owner migration after registry readiness, retained archival NBT and per-entity arena detachment

introduced.summary: Correct exclusive ownership and preserve inappropriate legacy claims as inactive history

history.summary: Original-profile diagnostics and active development JAR confirm the same defect. Preserve original profile and all legitimate entities

relations: BossProfile ownership -> spawn/load/death admission -> WorldTierData claim migration
Paladin support continues to follow its canonical structural boss arena
notes: No registered entity, scaling curve, defeat threshold, native loot, support tag or campaign boss roster changes
No live or offline world NBT is manually patched
unresolved: Player acceptance is unrun. Runtime migration applies when the updated artifact loads an existing world
